problem: A final-component symlink replacement after successful path resolution could make gate recording accept outside-project artifact bytes or JSON evidence.
change: Shared regular-file handle admission with no-follow where supported, descriptor/path identity comparison, containment recheck and streaming hashing. JSON evidence remains finite-byte bounded before and during reads. Canonical SQLite read-set selection remains first.
limitations: Four deterministic symlink controls are skipped on Windows; normal external-file and canonical gate controls still require current platform validation.
The tests prove this final-component replacement scenario, not universal protection from hostile concurrent filesystem topology changes.
Current full platform, resource, inclusive LOC and protocol completion remain open.
